B. Client : HSBC (Strategy & Change : SSV & Market Ops)
Data Remediation: Recon Standardization and Rationalization (Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Identified opportunities to rationalize, consolidate & minimize duplication of reconciliations (Trade, Cash & Position)
• Optimization of IT platforms/systems and data feeds.
• Identification of missings critical data elements.
• Ensure completeness of reconciliations from control stand-point
• Recommendation pertaining to decom of redundant, duplicate recons.
• Recommendation to enhance match rates in SIRE (internal AI based tool)
Page 1
C. Client : Morgan Stanley
1. Index/ETF Squad (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
As scrum master, I was managing all scrum ceremonies (daily scrum calls, backlog refinement, tech refinement, sprint
planning and retrospective). Responsible for tracking the BoW progress, stakeholder management etc. while working as
BA/PM on below mentioned projects
A. STOXX On boarding
• Working as Lead BA/PM on STOXX (Index data provider) on-boarding
• Responsible for end-to-end requirement gathering, vendor data analysis, data modelling, documentation, etc.
• Integration of multiple vendor files to create the golden copy
• Creation of cross referencing (X-ref) logic for golden copy creation
• Identification of impact of various corporate action events on indices and implementing the same basis data provided in
vendor files
• Automated the map-gap analysis for data migration/decom using SQL, Unix
• Creation of project plan, data migration plan/run-book & other artifacts like BRD, FRD, Project Charter etc.
• Keeping a track of project timelines and highlight the risks and impediments, as required
B. MSCI & S&P (N6) API On-boarding (Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Worked on analysis required to integrate/onboard the new MSCI & S&P API
• Identification of various API end points required to be considered for fetching the desired index header and composition
level data
• Impact analysis pertaining to various corporate action events and proposed implementation strategy for various index
variants
• Responsible for end-to-end requirement gathering, vendor data analysis, data modelling, documentation, etc.
• Creation of cross referencing (X-ref) logic for golden copy creation
C. Index/ETF DQ Tool Enhancements
• Proposed and implemented various enhancements pertaining to Index/ETF data quality tool (Legion UI)
• Creation of wireframes for addition of new functionalities/attributes to be exposed on UI
• Coordination with key business stakeholders for getting their approvals on new designs/layouts
2. Legacy Application Decom (Scrum Master cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Working on automation (idea proposed by me) of comparative vendor analysis for multiple vendors via SQL, UNIX and
Alteryx to ensure the smooth data on boarding from various vendors
• Automated (partially) the map-gap analysis for data migration/decom using SQL, Unix and AI/ML tools
• Creation of project plan, data migration plan/run-book & other artifacts like BRD, FRD, Project Charter etc.
• Keeping a track of project timelines and highlight the risks and impediments, as required
Page 2
• Map-gap analysis for comparing the “As Is” and “To Be” state
• Mapping the data attributes from legacy application to new application
• Investigation of raw files from various vendors, identification of cross referencing (match and merge) logic
• Identification and implementation of transformation and business rule applicable for each attribute
• Proposal of vendor hierarchy on the basis of accuracy and completeness scores (confidence scores) pertaining to each
vendor
• Ensuring that data model remains intact to ensure that there is no downstream impact
• Performing functional and UAT testing like creating test data, writing and executing test cases
• Writing test cases and performing the UAT
• Representing squad in working group, vendor governance meetings, acquiring BU approvals and sign-offs
3. EMIR (Derivatives Regulation) Sourcing and Recon Utility
• On boarding of EMIR data from Refinitiv
• Comparison of vendor data vs client’s internal master data
• Setting up frame work for various reports pertaining to EMIR
• Data modelling, artefact creation
4. Creation of Multi Source UI
• Worked on creation of a multi-source UI which enables ops users to perform a real time comparison of data from multiple
vendors/sources such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv and Exchange Data Feeds
5. MIFID II Recon (Internal reference data vs ESMA/FCA data) - (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Created schema for on-boarding a complex data files from ESMA and FCA
• Decoding complex business logics from legacy system & replicating same logics on ESMA/FCA data.
• Use of data normalization, transformation for creating appropriate data models
• Created 10+ customized recon report for transaction reporting team
• Recon of 35 (simple) and 27 (complex) attributes through intellimatch.
• Analysis and onboarding of 20 complex/huge ESMA/FCA feed files (size ≈ 100GB) containing approx. 20 million rows and
180+ attributes in mongo DB
• Recon dashboard creation for displaying age wise exceptions at attribute level.
• Participated in Design Council Meetings and various vendor governance meetings
• Responsible for writing test cases and performing UAT
6. MIFID II – Direct Sourcing from ESMA/FCA (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Eliminating the dependency on external data vendor (Refinitiv) by alternatively sourcing the data directly from ESMA/FCA
which is available free of cost.
• Data modelling, artefact creation.
Page 3
7. Creation of Bulk Upload Utility (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• A bulk upload tool was created to upload ESMA/FCA data in client’s internal database
• This eliminated the ops dependency on QAPM to perform multiple backend update on daily basis
• Implementation of overrides while performing backend updates
8. SFTR Implementation (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• Integration of reference data pertaining to SFTR into client’s database
• RFB implementation on the basis of recommendations from transactions reporting team
• Data accuracy and completeness analysis performed for reportable attributes
• Enhanced instrument as well as entity level (LEI) data coverage by sourcing missing data from ANNA, Refinitiv, GLEIF and
Bloomberg, LEI-ISIN mapping file & GLEIF LEI data file.
9. EBR Implementation (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)
• On-boarding of reference data (from Rimes) pertaining to EBR into client’s database
• Involved in artifact creation, data quality enhancement, GUI creation, writing and executing test cases (UAT)
• Implemented system based control that permits only “Authorized Benchmark” to be used by client for trade booking
• Mapped ≈ 48K indices from Equities & 20K from FI universe, enhanced RIC coverage from 75% to 95%
10. Manual Touch Reduction
• Aim was to reduce the manual effort by ops by reducing the exceptions generated via various reports/RFBs
2. Capgemini (Client : UBS) June 2017 – Feb 2019
